4808-4812-5131-5241.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter as a Ninja copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-4054--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-4054--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-8095.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-8095.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1494-2230-5256-6566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in your graveyard.
1494-2230-5256-6566.description:
Cast Polukranos Unchained from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {4}{B}{G} and exiling six other cards from your graveyard, causing it to enter the battlefield with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Polukranos Unchained.
When Polukranos Unchained dies, Yuna triggers, putting twelve +1/+1 counters onto Sage of Hours.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Polukranos Unchained's power.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat every second extra turn until you run out of cards to pay the escape cost.

1643-2073-2438-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3310-7223-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
3310-7223-7855.description:
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc and Army due to Stalactite Dagger, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

698-2450-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-2450-4050-7639.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Will.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

757-5475-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

3750-5471-7348.notablePrerequisites: Obeka has power 8 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3750-5471-7348.description:
Deal combat damage using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least eight upkeep phases after this phase.
Move to the first upkeep step. At the beginning of that upkeep, Replicating Ring triggers, putting a night counter on it. Then, if it has eight or more night counters, remove all of them and create eight Replicating Ring tokens.
Repeat step 2 during each remaining upkeep step.
Activate five Replicating Rings by tapping them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1283-2440-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {4}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
Repeat.
1283-2440-5685.notes: The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

2615-6562-7297.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-7297.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four Equipment.
Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4668-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

562-6747-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
562-6747-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat.

6758-6804.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness 2 or greater.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
6758-6804.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
6758-6804.description:
Activate Requiem Monolith by tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness 2 or greater.
Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Dawnsire, dealing 100 damage to the creature targeted in step 1.
The creature triggers, causing their controller to draw 100 cards and lose 100 life, thus losing the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2533-2719-4681-6798.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

1274-3641-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3641-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

372-813-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-2897-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Gigantoplasm and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-2897-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Gigantoplasm and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Gigantoplasm from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Gigantoplasm to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Gigantoplasm by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1987-2493-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

1077-4691-5919.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

2498-4067-5874.notablePrerequisites:
Sphinx of the Revelation does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {W} and a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2498-4067-5874.description:
Activate Sphinx of the Revelation by paying {W}{U}{U}, tapping it and paying at least {E}{E}{E}{E}, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Sheoldred triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Sheoldred trigger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx of the Revelation.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {W} or {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W} or {U}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have {W}{U}{U} available.
Repeat from step 1.
You may pay additional {E} if able to net near-infinite card draw.

1069-1374-1753-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-1753-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2105-4711-4836.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least two opponents.
2105-4711-4836.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant's myriad and printed abilities trigger.
Resolve the myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, not exiling the Combat Celebrant tokens due to The Master.
Repeat using a Combat Celebrant token that hasn't attacked this turn.

856-2438-5270.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

752-2686-4333.notablePrerequisites:
You own all permanents you control.
You control zero permanents with shroud, protection from instants, or protection from white.
752-2686-4333.description:
During the end step prior to your turn, float at least {1}{W}{B}.
Cast Leave by paying {1}{W}, returning all permanents you control except Barren Glory from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast One with Nothing by paying {B}, discarding your hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

413-2060-4772-5105.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
413-2060-4772-5105.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it six +1/+1 counters because of Doubling Season.
Remove all six counters getting {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Blasting Station tapping it to deal 1 damage.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all but one of the remaining floating mana giving it eight +1/+1 counters and untapping Blasting Station.
Remove all eight counters netting {8} of assorted colors containing at least {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7.
